best_idea: Resolve a cast in a fixed order (roll the fizzle and price at cast start, charge at resolution, re-check movement before charging, then roll one resist per target) so a broken cast never costs the caster what they should not pay.
decision_why: The order and the one-roll-per-decision logistic shape fit a server-side fight step; the donor double mana roll with a luck term is too noisy for a fast duel, so keep one roll.
acceptance: A server test moves the caster 6.5 units after windup start and asserts outcome disrupted with mana unchanged; a fizzle deducts exactly the fizzle fee; a 30-point skill lead gives about 29 percent resist chance over 10,000 seeded rolls.
